invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list, as 'Collectors.toList()' never returns null.
File IDs in the list are built from FileSlice.getFileId(), which should not be null.
The method collects only distinct file IDs to the result list.
If result is empty, it means there were no file slices in the slice view for the partition.
The result list exactly equals the stream pipeline applied in the method body.
